findings.evidence: Change.lean:78-90; the two bodies are `rw [GridPoint.J_insert_left hab, GridPoint.J_insert_left hb, add_assoc]` and `rw [GridPoint.JCenter_insert_left hab, GridPoint.JCenter_insert_left hb, add_assoc]`, and `JFunction/Basic.lean:361` already provides the generic `JCount_insert_left`.
findings.fix: State it once at the general layer, `GridPoint.JCount_insert_pair_left (r₁ r₂) ... : JCount r₁ r₂ (insert a (insert b S)) P = JCount r₁ r₂ {a} P + JCount r₁ r₂ {b} P + JCount r₁ r₂ S P` (proof: `rw [JCount_insert_left hab, JCount_insert_left hb, add_assoc]`), and obtain both `J_insert_pair_left` and `JCenter_insert_pair_left` from it, since `J` and `JCenter` are defined as `JCount` at their two relations.
findings.issue: `JCenter_insert_pair_left` (86) is a verbatim copy of `J_insert_pair_left` (78) at the other instantiation — same statement, same one-line proof. The PR's own stated design is to state the pair-count API once, parametric in the relation, precisely to avoid this.

findings.evidence: Basic.lean:276-283 (definitions), Basic.lean:394,403 (`JNum`, `J` at `IsSouthWest IsSouthWest`), Center.lean:195-196,258-259 (`JNumCenter`, `JCenter` at `(· ≤ ·) IsSouthWest`); no other instantiation exists in the repo.
findings.fix: Drop `r₂`: define `JNumCount r s t := Icount r s t + I t s` and `JCount r s t := (JNumCount r s t : ℚ) / 2`, so `JNumCount_image_swap`/`JCount_image_swap` need only the single hypothesis on `r` (the `IsSouthWest` half is invariant unconditionally by `isSouthWest_swap`).
findings.issue: `JNumCount r₁ r₂` and `JCount r₁ r₂` take two relation parameters, but `r₂` is instantiated to `IsSouthWest` at every use site — `JNum := JNumCount IsSouthWest IsSouthWest`, `J := JCount IsSouthWest IsSouthWest`, `JNumCenter := JNumCount (· ≤ ·) IsSouthWest`, `JCenter := JCount (· ≤ ·) IsSouthWest`. The second parameter is abstraction with no use, and it costs every downstream lemma an extra `[DecidableRel r₂]` and every `image_swap` lemma a second invariance hypothesis.

summary: The relation-parametric `Icount`/`JCount` layer is at the right level and the graph-count lemmas are correctly stated without permutation hypotheses, but the PR deletes the general point-set integrality lemma and re-proves it twice at the diagram level, duplicates the insert-pair helper instead of stating it once at `JCount`, and gives `JNumCount`/`JCount` a second relation parameter that never varies.
